title: "Tighten the Supply Chain a Bit." He Said It From Prison

lines.say: There has to be some way to tighten the supply chain a bit. Martin Shkreli said that in August twenty nineteen, recorded from federal prison.
lines.show: "There has to be some way to tighten the supply chain a bit." Martin Shkreli said that in August 2019, recorded from federal prison.

scene.q: [T]here has to be some way to tighten the supply chain a bit . . .
scene.cite: As quoted in FTC v. Vyera, Opinion & Order (S.D.N.Y. 2022)

lines.say: He meant Daraprim, the drug his company raised from seventeen sixty to seven hundred fifty dollars a tablet. A judge found he kept directing the company from inside.
lines.show: He meant Daraprim, the drug his company raised from $17.60 to $750 a tablet. A judge found he kept directing the company from inside.

scene.kicker: FTC v. VYERA · FINDINGS OF FACT

lines.say: In twenty twenty-two, the court banned him from the drug industry for life, and ordered sixty-four point six million dollars disgorged.
lines.show: In 2022, the court banned him from the drug industry for life, and ordered $64.6 million disgorged.

lines.say: Real trials. Real evidence. The verdict.
